brief: Empties a file, keeping its old text in memory; the file stays on the disk with no content.
detail: Reach for it to blank a file on purpose. Building the object empties the file at once; Erase empties it again. The old text stays readable through OriginalContent. The class name is spelt Earaser in the source. It does not delete the file: use stzFileManager.Delete for that.
receiver:
write("demo_note.txt", "alpha" + char(10) + "beta gamma" + char(10) + "end")
o1 = new stzFileEaraser("demo_note.txt")
